Game Overview

In Sushi Drop, the core idea is straightforward: guide the charming Sushi Brothers through intricate puzzles in Sushi Drop, an arcade adventure where precise timing and strategic maneuvering are key. Drag and drop sushi past dynamic obstacles while collecting bonuses. Navigate traditional culinary ceremonies to keep plates full and customers delighted in this vibrant, fast-paced challenge.
